title: Zork I
goal: 350 points: every treasure in the trophy case
intro: You're playing Zork I, the classic text adventure, with your Zork tools. The goal is treasure and points: 350 is a perfect score. Explore, pick up anything useful, read what you find, and keep a light source once you go underground - the dark has a grue in it.
feel: grues are scary; treasure is exciting
